package.name: omni_camera
package.description: omni-robot camera head (design.md 4.9): libcamera_capture publishes a CSI camera as /cam/<side>/image_raw, stamped with the sensor's own timestamp, and camera_head.launch.py composes it with omni_cpp's catch_perception (intra-process) so the head sends tracks, not images. Needs Raspberry Pi's libcamera fork (built from source, not a rosdep key: Ubuntu's libcamera 0.2 can't drive Pi cameras); without it only the launch file installs.
